title: Ethiopian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with lamb, rich berbere spice, and authentic Ethiopian flavors.

ingredients.name: berbere spice
ingredients.notes: make sure to toast before using for best flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear lamb pieces until browned, then set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and cook onion, garlic, and ginger until softened.
Add berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for another minute.
Add beef broth and water, scraping up any browned bits.
Return lamb to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
